#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;
int K;
struct Result {
    int matrix[MAXK][MAXK];
    int inside[MAXK];
    bool exist[MAXK];

    Result() {
        memset(matrix, 0, sizeof(matrix));
        memset(inside, 0, sizeof(inside));
        memset(exist, 0, sizeof(exist));
    }

    Result(const Result &other, int rot) {
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            exist[(i + rot) % K] = other.exist[i];
            inside[(i + rot) % K] = other.inside[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                matrix[(i + rot) % K][(j + rot) % K] = other.matrix[i][j];
            }
        }
    }

    Result(const Result &a, const Result &b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            exist[i] = a.exist[i] || b.exist[i];
            inside[i] = a.inside[i];
            if (!a.exist[i]) inside[i] = (inside[i] + b.inside[i]) % MOD;
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                inside[i] = (inside[i] + (long long)a.matrix[i][j] * b.inside[j]) % MOD;
                matrix[i][j] = 0;
                if (!b.exist[j]) matrix[i][j] = a.matrix[i][j];
                if (!a.exist[i]) matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] + b.matrix[i][j]) % MOD;
                for (int m = 0; m < K; m++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] + (long long)a.matrix[i][m] * b.matrix[m][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

Result pk[MAXD];
int digits[MAXD];

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n >> K;
    int dcount = 0;
    for (long long x = n; x > 0; x /= K) {
        digits[dcount++] = x % K;
    }
    pk[0].exist[0] = true;
    pk[0].inside[0] = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
        pk[0].matrix[0][j] = 1;
    }
    for (int p = 1; p < dcount; p++) {
        pk[p] = pk[p - 1];
        for (int v = 1; v < K; v++) {
            pk[p] = Result(pk[p], Result(pk[p - 1], v));
        }
    }
    Result res;
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = dcount - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int v = 0; v < digits[i]; v++) {
            res = Result(res, Result(pk[i], (sum + v) % K));
        }
        sum += digits[i];
    }
    long long total = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        total = (total + res.inside[i]) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
